faq_q1: Is PDF Studio completely free to use?
faq_a1: Yes, PDF Studio is 100% free with no subscriptions, paywalls, or hidden charges.
faq_q2: Are my PDF files uploaded to any external server?
faq_a2: No. Your files never leave your browser. All PDF processing happens locally on your computer or device.
faq_q3: What is the maximum file size supported?
faq_a3: The maximum file size limit is 10 MB per PDF document to ensure fast and reliable in-browser memory execution.
faq_q4: What tools does PDF Studio offer?
faq_a4: PDF Studio provides PDF compression, merging multiple files, page rotation, signature drawing, password protection/unlocking, content redaction, page reordering/extraction, grayscale conversion, and document text editing.
